test_title: PYST 3: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct sentence:

(1) The lights went out suddenly, plunging the room into darkness.

(2) He quickly grabbed a flashlight from the drawer.

(3) Tom was reading a novel in the living room.

(4) Power was restored after ten minutes.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 
• The correct sequence for the sentences is **3-1-2-4**. 
 
• The paragraph begins with introducing Tom in the living room reading a novel, setting the scene. 
 
• **Sentence 3 is the first sentence** as it establishes the setting: 
 
 
• "Tom was reading a novel in the living room." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence 1 follows** because the lights going out suddenly creates a disruption in the scene: 
 
 
• "The lights went out suddenly, plunging the room into darkness." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence 2 comes next** as it describes Tom's immediate reaction to the darkness: 
 
 
• "He quickly grabbed a flashlight from the drawer." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4 is the last** as it resolves the situation and concludes the narrative: 
 
 
• "Power was restored after ten minutes." 
 
 

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Tom was reading a novel in the living room. The lights went out suddenly, plunging the room into darkness. He quickly grabbed a flashlight from the drawer. Power was restored after ten minutes."</div
